testName: Omni-Channel Real-Time Work Routing & Agent Capacity Distribution
steps:
1. Log in as Support Agent persona
2. In Omni-Channel utility widget, change presence status from "Offline" to "Available - Cases"
3. In separate session, trigger new High-Priority Case routed to Tier 1 Queue
4. Verify Omni-Channel widget rings / flashes with new incoming Case work item
5. Click "Accept Work" button
6. Verify Case tab opens in Service Console workspace and agent capacity reflects consumed units
